metadata.description: AI-powered cybersecurity, automation, and AI safety plugins by PEACH STUDIO. Research-driven tools for threat intelligence, security operations, and AI-augmented workflows.

plugins.name: idea-to-spec
plugins.description: Turn a loose idea for any tool or software into spec-driven artifacts: scope it, research options, write a PRD and epics, then codify each epic into validated OpenSpec changes (proposal → specs → design → tasks). Optional kickoff menu: Mermaid architecture, README + private git repo, prior-art research, tech-stack discussion.

plugins.name: business-profiler
plugins.description: Cybersecurity threat intelligence, attack surface assessment, and strategic sales targeting. 7 skills: full-profile, threat-profile, attack-surface, threat-actors, ot-ics-assessment, incident-lookup, sales-targeting.

plugins.name: email-verifier
plugins.description: Find and verify a work email without sending mail. Give it a name + company (it discovers the address) or an address to check. Cross-plane verification — SMTP RCPT fused with the Microsoft 365 Entra identity plane (GetFederationInformation + ROPC AADSTS differential) — confirms addresses even on accept-all tenants where plain SMTP is blind, with automatic sibling-domain fallback (mail domain vs login/UPN domain) and free keyless OSINT (Gravatar/GitHub/web). 1 skill: email-finder.

plugins.name: peach-vulnhunt
plugins.description: Hunt for real, exploitable vulnerabilities and produce disclosure-ready reports. Two skills: vulnhunt (modern web apps — IDOR/BOLA, broken access control, privilege escalation, OWASP Top 10) and sysvulnhunt (C/C++ system code — memory corruption, RCE, privilege escalation). Scan locally (private) or via AWS Bedrock (higher recall), triage, build PoCs, report. Powered by the foil scanner.
